::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 19th [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 47-48
:::

My dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
[The Clever Woman of the Family](cmy_books/cmybook_58.qmd) as far as she goes will be sent you in a day or two from a friend who had had her to read.

The [illustrations](organizations/other_167.qmd) are decidedly not successful and I should not wish to perpetuate them. They are not half so good as what [Miss Keary](people/person_793.qmd)’s young [cousin](people/person_887.qmd) does.[^1]

There is about a fourth more of the story to come.

I have nearly finished the [Golden Deeds](cmy_books/cmybook_51.qmd), but alas the Lotty story has eluded me twice again. However I have quite enough for the pages.

Yours very truly
C. M. Yonge

---

[^1]: Katie Johns, who was related to the novelist Annie Keary (1825-1879).
